form_factor.value: handheld and desktop terminal following the latest two uploaded reference images: low horizontal base, raised rear sloping screen housing, exposed flat front deck; not a single shallow wedge

value.implementation: Pi native USB-A, no baseboard socket, hub or extension cable

usb_c_role.value: charging and power input only; peripherals use USB-A

primary_use.value: Linux terminal, SSH and portable tools

local_input.value: Prototype baseboard provides power, display and a user-replaceable front-deck GPIO module interface; no fixed navigation/confirm/back button bank; text and navigation via external keyboard on Pi native USB

battery_runtime_test.value: 20–25 C; no added illumination or USB-powered peripherals; Wi-Fi connected; terminal open with a low-traffic SSH session and periodic text updates. Separately characterize runtime with a wired USB keyboard; do not claim the baseline covers it.

battery_architecture.value: Internal factory-protected 1S Li-ion pack, nominal 3.7V/3300mAh, user-supplied against the baseboard battery interface specification; not an arbitrary bare cell.

value: no reboot on external power insertion or removal
controlled Linux shutdown before battery cutoff

appearance.value: orange integral screen housing with a shallow darkenable border line on an ivory low horizontal base; flat front deck

screen_mount.value: fixed-angle raised rear screen housing on horizontal base; no hinge

value.status: provisional corrected styling envelope, not verified hardware fit

prototype_process.value: FDM enclosure; STEP CAD handoff; printing preparation separately scoped

display_interface.value: 10-terminal serial interface with COM inversion; not HDMI; GPIO electrical compatibility and power sequencing require implementation verification

value: With all power disconnected, user mates their Pi4B to the baseboard GPIO socket and mechanically secures it; baseboard powers Pi and LS027B7DH01 terminal operates without an internal USB-C power cable.
Use external keyboard on Pi native USB for navigation and shell commands; no added navigation keys or baseboard USB-A.
demonstrate an SSH session over Wi-Fi
measure and report actual runtime in the defined no-USB-peripheral light-use baseline and separately with a USB keyboard; no fixed minimum-hour pass/fail threshold
operate and charge concurrently without reboot on power transition
recognize keyboard and storage on USB-A within a declared power budget; USB-C carries input power only
verify display clamping, FPC routing, battery clearance, thermals and desktop stability

Verify GPIO docking orientation, contact current/temperature, reverse-current protection and PiUSB-C cover interlock preventing simultaneous source connection; no hot-plug or multi-model compatibility claim.

User installs Pi without soldering or individual jumper wiring; verify enclosure openings and real plug/cable insertion, release and bend clearance for accessible native ports other than coveredPiUSB-C, plus microSD service access. Ports accessible does not certify concurrent powered use.

ValidatePiUSB-Ccover interlock: coveropenorwirebreak musthardware-inhibitGPIOsource; portcannotacceptplugwhileGPIOsourceenabled; verifybreak-before-access/discharge timing and noautomaticrestartaftercoverclosure. Normalservice requiresLinuxshutdown andbatteryisolation first.

local_button_default.value: Current lite enclosure has no side power/shutdown button, button cap or corresponding opening; use software shutdown.

battery_runtime_policy.value: No fixed minimum runtime; evaluate and report actual runtime for selected hardware and use conditions rather than requiring two hours.

compute_supply_model.value: User supplies Raspberry Pi; product is our custom baseboard and peripherals, not a bundled Raspberry Pi

compute_attachment.value: Simple installation of user-owned Pi4B onto our baseboard by GPIO docking and minimal mechanical fastening; no separate internal Pi power cable

supported_compute_scope.value: Initial compatibility target Raspberry Pi 4 Model B,4GB reference configuration; other Raspberry Pi models not qualified by header similarity alone

pi_power_interface.value: Baseboard regulated and protected5V to Pi via40-pin header power contacts; SPI/control via3.3V-domain signal contacts; cold-plug only

pi_native_port_access.value: Enclosure exposesPi nativeinterfaces forplugaccess exceptPi ownUSB-C,which hasaninterlockedcoverwhiledocked. UsePi nativeUSB-A,notaddedbaseboardUSB-A.

installation_default.value: Preassembledbaseboard: userinstallsPiwithsystemmicroSD,cold-plugsGPIOsocket,fastensPiandclosesinterlockedcover/case; no soldering orindividualjumperwiring. Nativeboard-edgeports accessibleexceptcoveredPiUSB-C; microSDserviceaccess. No CSI/DSIbreakouts. Accessdoesnotexpandexisting500mAperipheralbudget.

pi_usb_c_docked_use.value: Lite variant: Pi native USB-C is the sole power input and must be accessible when docked. Full variant: original interlocked cover and baseboard USB-C input remain required.

battery_supply_model.value: User will source a compatible battery; proceed with baseboard development without waiting for an agent-selected battery MPN. Battery is excluded from kit procurement.

development_order.value: CAD styling before PCB; appearance is important. Use exterior design to guide later board layout.

cad_first_scope.value: First CAD delivery is an editable exterior visual study, not final hardware fit or a printable production enclosure; preserve final electrical/assembly requirements for subsequent integration.

value.front_groove: replaced by a removable blank module in a common locating seat

screen_angle_direction.value: Reduce the steep screen slope toward the shallow red-line profile in mark.png; no exact angle specified.

external_port_location.value: All external cable interfaces on rear or sides, none on front; reserve openings for Pi native USB and RJ45.

rear: Pi 4 USB-A sockets in two stacks
value.pi_own_usb_c: accessible supply input in active lite variant; full variant interlock remains separate
value.microSD: internal service after removal of bottom and isolation of all power

screen_pod_front_rise_datum.value: Nominal sharp intersection of sloping top and foremost housing plane, measured vertically above horizontal deck, including the existing0.3mm assembly seam; rounded edge rolls below nominal.

front_module_replaceability.value: The front-deck cover is a separate removable part in CAD and in the physical assembly, replaceable by user-designed expansion modules using the same flat deck support and four corner mounting points. The cover underside has no locating tongue or raised boss. The supplied blank has a flat outer face, with no central opening or raised patch, and leaves clearance above the internal female socket. Preserve display mounting and the accepted approximately1.67mm screen-pod rise above the fixed shell deck.

front_module_service_policy.value: Power off, disconnect external input and isolate the battery before removing or connecting a front module; no live hot swap claim.

single_baseboard_integration.value: One custom baseboard integrates the Sharp display interface, user-replaceable front GPIO expansion, battery charging and Pi 4B power supply; no separate board for these functions.

variant_scope_policy.value: Active lite variant has display and 8-contact expansion only; battery, charger, MCU, Pi supply and interlock requirements apply exclusively to retained full pi_baseboard variant.

lite_supply_entry.value: Pi native USB-C powers Pi; GPIO 5V pins supply only display and module branches. Enclosure must allow Pi USB-C in lite variant.

lite_module_service.value: Cold plug only; modules powered solely by AUX_3V3, no external supply and no 5V logic. Pinout is custom, not Pi header pins 1-8.

lite_fpc_placement.value: Horizontal side-entry FPC on top of compact PCB; opening toward down/front (-Y in top view). Native tail folds behind panel with exposed copper upward; use top contacts and verify installation access.

value.display: Compatible modeled top-contact FPC; exact replacement delegated to agent
value.intent: Higher Pi socket, lower 8pin expansion socket, horizontal top-contact FPC opening toward lower/front side.

native_tail_estimation_authorization.value: Proceed using an agent-estimated screen-tail length and allow reasonable assembly clearance rather than waiting for a physical measurement.

value.datum: Glass exit edge to tail tip measured along tail; includes stiffener and inserted length.

value.note: 0.5mm is additional free-space clearance, not cable-length extension. Manufacturer bend limits retained. Slot stop and pin1 still require evidence.

lite_baseboard_attachment.value: Raise the compact PCB toward the screen and fasten it to the upper enclosure; its support must not rely on the bottom cover or removable front module blank.

value.note: Agent default lowered to provide air space while retaining higher-socket engagement.

lite_upper_shell_thermal_space.value: Avoid upper-shell contact by PCB and connectors; leave air space above electronics while PCB remains fixed to upper shell.

value.note: Geometric air-space target only; temperatures and airflow not tested.

processor_memory_cooling.value: Add a small fan and heatsinks for the Pi4B processor and memory area in the current compact enclosure.

value.heatsink: Geekworm P165-B standalone,65x55x11mm, four M2.5 threaded mounting corners
value.fan: Nidec F16FB-05LLC,16x16x4.5mm,5V40mA; retain existing selected fan
value.fan_control: always on when Pi5V is present; no logic GPIO used
value.connector: JST SM02B-SRSS-TB side-entry 1mm 2pin, bottom HAT side; pin1 +5V, pin2 GND
value.mounting: Four countersunk M2.5x6 screws through upper-shell lower corner shelves and the unchanged Pi mounting holes into metal heatsink threads. No independent heatsink bracket.
value.geometry_evidence: Heatsink overall size and mounting pattern manufacturer-backed; reliefs and undersurface are explicit photo-derived references, not vendor STEP.
value.thermal_validation: Prototype load-temperature and airflow tests still required.
value.airflow: Upward blower intake and left-side exhaust; front exhaust closed. Rear-left external inlet removed by user; installed replacement air path and cooling performance unmeasured.

compact_cooling_enclosure_priority.value: Prioritize keeping the current compact enclosure while completing fan/heatsink selection, power, airflow and CAD fit verification together.

compute_board_corner_mounting.value: Mainboard must screw to upper shell at all four corner mounting holes; cooler mounting is independent.

flush_fasteners.value: Use M3 countersunk screws for most enclosure fasteners where the available geometry permits, prioritizing user-owned M3x6, M3x10 and M3x12 lengths. Retain smaller fasteners where original board holes, metal threads or narrow printed features require them.

cooler_mounting.value: Use the user-selected Pi4B passive heatsink directly on the compute board, without a separate upper-shell heatsink bracket; add an internal fan supplied through the HAT from GPIO power contacts.

pcb_fastener_seat_policy.value: Preserve the Pi original cylindrical mounting holes and P165-B M2.5 metal threads; use M2.5x10 countersunk screws in the printed bottom carrier. Preserve the baseboard 2.2mm holes and two M2x3 socket-cap screws directly against the PCB underside, without screw spacers. Enclosure printed receivers are solved by the screwjoint kit; apply print allowance only to through/head seats.

fan_power_takeoff.value: HAT routes GPIO-header 5V and GND to an internal fan connector.

lite_left_charging_opening.value: Remove the unused left-side baseboard charging opening; active lite enclosure has a continuous left wall at the fan support. Pi native USB-C remains the supply entrance.

cooling_exhaust_direction.value: Hot exhaust must not blow toward the front of the terminal.

value.top: All populated components except J_PI, including buffers, passives, power branches, FPC, module and fan connectors
value.purpose: Single front SMT placement/reflow side; Pi female socket fitted separately

lite_pcb_area_policy.value: PCB area may increase to avoid unnecessary crowding; prefer comfortable component spacing and front-only population.

value.approach: Fill former electronics recess while preserving Pi, module, screw and rear guide datums; screen screw notch retained

rear_left_wall_openings.value: Remove the four rear-left wall inlet slots below the screen pod; restore a continuous wall. Keep the left-side blower exhaust slots.

enclosure_flush_screen_outline.value: 机身与屏幕凸起两侧齐宽；屏舱背部按用户紫线做上沿向前内收的斜面，下沿仍与机身后沿齐平，不留侧面或背面的水平台阶。

enclosure_vent_profile.value: 左前侧保留的四个通风孔采用圆角长孔。

value.approach: Narrow the case and pod together to76mm. Pi/heatsink move5mm left and fan3mm right; re-layout J_PI while retaining the LCD FPC and expansion socket datums. Front screen retainer screws move toX+/-27mm.

enclosure_rear_wall_profile.value: 屏幕凸起的后壁按上传侧视图紫线向前倾斜，上端内收、下端接齐机身后壁。

compact_enclosure_and_narrow_frame.value: 收窄fascia屏幕边框并缩小机身；接受为此修改定制基板。

screen_pod_equal_border.value: 屏幕舱上下左右四边等宽并收窄；接受前沿随此从1mm升至约1.67mm，保留屏幕玻璃、13°倾角和FPC安装基准。

value.window_role: 浅分界线外轮廓；玻璃有效显示口为59.4×35.88mm，独立定位框取消

screen_frame_construction.value: 一体屏舱前框和等厚后压框；前框集成玻璃定位口，取消独立内框、背面薄翻边及排线护栏。两个硬质打印件以四枚M2螺丝连接，软垫另计。

value.orientation: 一体前框的屏面朝下；等厚后压框平放。PLA、0.2mm层高为样机默认，切片和实物试配另验。

countersink_print_margin.value: Provide additional countersink seating space to accommodate printing tolerances.
